one_month_reasoning: One scheduled event in the window: Q3 2026 results Tue 2026-11-10 before the open (call 8:30am ET; guide net sales 36-37M, non-GAAP EPS -0.20 to -0.12 [5]). Base rate from its own 4 prints: revenue beat the guide midpoint 4/4 (median +8.4%) and EPS beat the top of the range 4/4 [1-5,12]; the May print moved the stock +45% in a day [25], so the event adds a fat tail both ways. Against that: the beat record is known and priced, the guide flags supply constraints [5], and the stock is in a downtrend (90.48 June close to 43.31 on 11-02, 44.68 on 11-03 [15]); short-horizon momentum points down. Net: median 45.0 (the 11-03 close 44.68 plus a slight tilt for a probable beat; round 1 used 43.6 off the 11-02 close), lognormal spread 0.25 for the month (annual vol 82%/3.5 = 0.23, widened a little for the print). Nothing in the supervisor's findings changes the one-month view: the peer-basis and interest fixes move the 12-month research target (12m), not the print.

model_inputs.ebit_basis_note: EBIT = company non-GAAP gross profit - non-GAAP operating expense - D&A = GAAP loss from operations + SBC + severance + IPO-related bonus and transaction costs - the 2025 non-monetary gain (Ex.99.1 reconciliations). Q2 2026: -8.727 + 3.557 = -5.170 = 15.989 - 19.374 - 1.785 [5]. The company's own non-GAAP figures exclude D&A as well as SBC, so its "non-GAAP operating loss" (GP - opex) is EBITDA-like; this set deducts D&A to keep EBIT an EBIT (engine ebitda = ebit + da = the company figure). EPS in notes = company non-GAAP net loss per share (excl. SBC and D&A, incl. other income) on weighted basic shares, the basis of the guide and Street (StockAnalysis/Benzinga). Engine model EPS = EBIT / diluted shares (no other income) and is lower; Zacks figures are on a different, GAAP-like basis.
